;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Paris explosion]]
**A large explosion caused by a suspected [[gas leak]] destroys a bakery in the [[9th arrondissement of Paris|9th arrondissement]] of [[Paris]], [[France]]. Four people are killed, and 40 others are injured. [https://news.sky.com/story/loud-explosion-in-central-paris-police-11605330 (Sky News)]
*At least 21 miners die after a roof collapses in a coal mine in [[Shenmu]], [[China]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-46853982 (BBC News)]
*At least 17 are killed and 12 others are injured in a fire at a drug rehabilitation clinic in [[Guayaquil]], [[Ecuador]]. Officials said the blaze took hold after patients set mattresses on fire in a bid to escape the facility. [https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-17-dead-and-a-dozen-injured-in-ecuador-following-fire-at-rehab-clinic-11605629 (Sky News)]

;Politics and elections
*Aftermath of the [[2019 Gabonese coup d'état attempt]]
**[[Gabon]]'s [[President of Gabon|president]] [[Ali Bongo Ondimba]] names [[Julien Nkoghe Bekale]] as the country's new [[Prime Minister of Gabon|prime minister]] after a failed [[coup]] that happened five days ago. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gabon-politics/gabons-bongo-names-new-prime-minister-after-thwarted-coup-attempt-idUSKCN1P6095 (Reuters)]
*[[United States federal government shutdown of 2018–2019]]
**On its 22nd day, the federal government shutdown becomes the longest in American history overtaking the record previously set in [[United States federal government shutdowns of 1995–1996|1995–1996]]. [https://www.news.com.au/world/north-america/us-government-shutdown-hits-third-week-as-trump-considers-taking-disaster-funds-to-build-wall/news-story/f82153c41b14f47f717d1b46a8a6aed4 (News Limited)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Joining several other Democrats in the race, [[Julian Castro]], who served as [[United States Secretary of Housing and Urban Development|Secretary of Housing and Urban Development]] from 2014 to 2017, announces his intention to run in the 2020 United States presidential election. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/01/12/politics/julian-castro-presidential-announcement/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**The Congolese election commission announces that parties supporting outgoing president [[Joseph Kabila]] obtained the majority in the [[National Assembly (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/dr-congo-divided-over-opposition-chiefs-election-112354286.html (Yahoo News)]
*[[Politics of Taiwan]]
** Taiwanese premier [[William Lai]] announces his resignation and former premier [[Su Tseng-chang]] succeeds him. [http://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2019/01/12/2003707770 (''Taipei Times'')]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[Censorship of Wikipedia]]
**All editions of [[Wikipedia]] are blocked in [[Venezuela]] by state-owned [[CANTV]] amid an ongoing political crisis. [https://netblocks.org/reports/wikipedia-blocked-in-venezuela-as-internet-controls-tighten-XaAwR08M (Netblocks)]
